lede: Detroit Lions carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#7 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Carolina Panthers +3.5 with a fair total of 49.5 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Detroit Lions pass offence vs Carolina Panthers pass defence, which sits +0.202 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
